fields.name: OTHER-PROPERTIES
fields.target: Now you've done it. It seems that the brick has other properties than weight, namely the ability to blow you to smithereens.

fields.name: FATAL-VAPORS
fields.target: As you pass out, you realize that the vapors from the flask's contents are fatal.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the Vault of the Bank of Zork, in which there are no doors.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: Nestled in the chest is a wrought gold statuette of a dragon.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are at the top of the well. Well done. There are etchings on the side of the well. There is a small crack across the floor at the entrance to a room on the east, but it can be crossed easily.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a solid steel cage in the middle of the room.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are on a narrow ledge within an old dormant volcano. This ledge is about halfway between the floor below and the rim above. There is an exit to the south.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow. There are exits here to the east and the south.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a gazebo in the midst of a formal garden. It is cool and restful here. A tea table adorns the center of the gazebo.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a dead sea serpent in a heap here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: The Wizard of Frobozz is here, eyeing you warily.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: CROSS
fields.target: You'll have to specify a direction.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are standing on a crude but sturdy wooden foot bridge crossing a deep ravine. The path runs north and south from here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a dented steel box here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a matchbook saying "Visit ZORK I" here.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target:
">> Visit Exotic ZORK I <<

Consult the Frobozz Magic Travel Agency, or visit your local computer store for more details."

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a beautiful unicorn here cropping grass.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a beautiful red crystal sphere here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is an arched hall of fine marble. The hall stops abruptly to the north at a ford across a stream, where the marble is cracked and broken. Perhaps a flood or collapse of the cave was responsible. To the south the hall opens into a large room. There is rather annoying whirring sound coming from that room.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a clear crystal sphere lying in the sand.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a baby sea serpent swimming in the aquarium.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: In the center of the table sits a blue crystal sphere.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are about one hundred feet above the bottom of the volcano. The top of the volcano is clearly visible here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a strange black sphere here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a former broom closet. The exits are to the east and west.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: The leak has submerged the depressed area in a pool of tears. There is a hazy something at the deepest part of the pool.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A handsome book, bound in green leather, sits in the center of the room.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A stoppered glass flask with a skull-and-crossbones marking is here. The flask is filled with some clear liquid.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: There is a skull-and-crossbones engraved on the glass.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the workshop of the Wizard of Frobozz.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This room was the office of the Chairman of the Bank of Zork. Like the other rooms here, it has been extensively vandalized. The lone exit is to the north.

fields.name: OUT
fields.target: You may not recall, but when you entered, the door of the barrow shut behind you. There is no way out.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are inside an ancient barrow hidden deep within a dark forest. The barrow opens into a narrow tunnel at its southern end. You can see a faint glow at the far end.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a wooden bucket here, 3 feet in diameter and 3 feet high.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are at the southern edge of a great cavern. To the south across a shallow ford is a dark tunnel which looks like it was once enlarged and smoothed. To the north a narrow path winds among stalagmites. Dim light illuminates the cavern.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target:
This is a dingy closet adjacent to a larger room to the north. Chiselled into a wall are these words:

     Protected by
       FROBOZZ
 Magic Alarm Company
  (Hello, footpad!)

There doesn't seem to be any footpad here, however.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a card with writing on it here.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target:
Warning:
    This room was constructed over very weak rock strata. Detonation of explosives in this room is strictly prohibited!
         Frobozz Magic Cave Company
         per M. Agrippa, foreman

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: The portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead is here.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead hangs on the wall.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A huge dead dragon is lying half blocking the stream.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a vicious-looking dog guarding the entrance. It is more or less your usual dog, except that it has three heads and is the size of an elephant.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a balloon here, broken into pieces.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: Worn and battered in one corner of the room is a blue book.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the Wizard's trophy room, filled with memorabilia of various sorts. On one wall is the Wizard's D. T. (Doctor of Thaumaturgy) degree from GUE Tech. Several old magic wands are mounted on a wand rack. A collection of dull and nicked swords testify to the fate of many foolhardy adventurers. Small bottles contain discarded homunculi (a few preserved in alcohol). There is a stuffed owl on a perch.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a small, bare room with no distinguishing features. There are no exits from this room.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a small hook attached to the rock here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: Shards of a smashed trophy case litter the room.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A long wooden club lies on the ground near the diamond-shaped window. The club is curiously burned at the thick end.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: The words "Babe Flathead" are burned into the wood.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A gigantic dog collar, large enough for three rhinoceros-sized dogs, is lying amidst the debris.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a Flathead stamp here.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: This three zorkmid stamp bears a portrait of Lord Dimwit Flathead, "Our Excessive Leader".

fields.name: CROSS
fields.target: You'll have to specify a direction.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the middle of a ruined but still impressive stone bridge spanning a deep chasm. Water flows far beneath. A paved path leads north into a large open space. To the south, the path leads into a misty tunnel.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A rotten old wooden chest is in one corner among the debris.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a large room, one half of which is depressed. Salty water flows from a large leak in the ceiling. The only exit is to the west.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are high above the floor of the volcano. The rim of the volcano looks very narrow and you are very near it. To the east is what appears to be a viewing ledge, too thin to land on.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target:
This is a large room full of assorted heavy machinery, whirring noisily. The room smells of burned resistors. Along one wall are three buttons which are, respectively, round, triangular, and square. Naturally, above these buttons are instructions written in EBCDIC. A large sign in English above all the buttons says
       "DANGER -- HIGH VOLTAGE"
There are exits to the west and the south.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a small hook attached to the rock here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: In this room, inscribed on the floor, is a great pentagram drawn with black chalk. In its center is a black circle.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target:
This is the entrance hall of the Bank of Zork, the largest banking institution of the Great Underground Empire. A partial account of its history is in "The Lives of the Twelve Flatheads," in the chapter on J. Pierpont Flathead. A more detailed history (albeit less objective) may be found in Flathead's outrageous autobiography "I'm Rich and You Aren't - So There!". Most of the furniture has been ravaged by passing scavengers. All that remains are two signs at the northwest and northeast corners of the room, which say:

    <--  VIEWING ROOMS  -->

The way out (ornate but tasteful) is to the east.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This room is the Wizard's workroom. A hall continues east and west, and a larger room lies to the south. There are many shelves and racks on the walls, but the Wizard's workbench dominates the room. It is made of dark, heavy wood bound with iron. The workbench is stained from many years of use, and is deeply gouged as though some huge clawed animal was imprisoned on it. There are burn marks and even notes written in a crabbed hand. Many arcane items are scattered about the bench; alembics, mortar and pestle, small knives of various sizes, odd scraps of vellum, wax candles, and much more. In the center of a relatively clear area of the bench are affixed three stands - ruby, sapphire, and diamond - which form a triangle.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a moby ruby lying here.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: On the floor lies a moby ruby.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: The room is cluttered with debris from an explosion. The walls seem ready to collapse.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target:
This room was used by holders of safety deposit boxes to view their contents. On the north side of the room is a sign which says

"Remain here while the teller retrieves your safety deposit box. When you are finished, leave the box, and exit to the south. Safety deposit boxes cannot be removed from this room!

Thank You for Banking at the Zork!"

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are trapped inside a solid steel cage.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are about two hundred feet above the volcano floor. Looming above is the rim of the volcano. There is a small ledge on the west side.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: "Here lie the Flatheads, whose heads were placed on poles by the Keeper of the Dungeon for amazing untastefulness."

fields.name: CROSS
fields.target: It is impossible to cross this distance.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are on a ledge in the middle of a large volcano. Below you the volcano bottom can be seen and above is the rim of the volcano. A couple of ledges can be seen on the other side of the volcano; it appears that this ledge is intermediate in elevation between those on the other side. The exit from this room is to the east.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a damp circular room, whose walls are made of brick and mortar. The roof of this room is not visible, but there appear to be some etchings on the walls. There is a passageway to the west.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: WEST
fields.target: A great chasm blocks your way.

fields.name: NW
fields.target: A great chasm blocks your way.

fields.name: DOWN
fields.target: A great chasm blocks your way.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is an enormous room, in the center of which are four wooden posts delineating a rectangular area, above which is what appears to be a wooden roof. In fact, all objects in this room appear to be abnormally large. To the east is a passageway. There are large gaping chasms to the west and northwest.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are on a narrow ledge near the bottom of a deep ravine. The ledge continues to the west. A precarious climb up to another tiny ledge is possible. A short scramble down the rock face leads to a stream.

fields.name: NE
fields.target: You are trying to walk through an enormous rock.

fields.name: OUT
fields.target: You are trying to walk through an enormous rock.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This room looks like it was once a kennel for a very large dog (some of the bones would fit a dinosaur). It apparently hasn't been used for a long time, as the dust is fairly thick all over. The only exit is northeast.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: Imbedded in the wall is an ornate trophy cabinet.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a package of candied goodies here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a Gnome of Zurich here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a pearl necklace here with hundreds of large pearls.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This must have been a large library, probably for the royal family. All of the shelves have been gnawed to pieces by unfriendly gnomes. To the north is an exit.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a blue label here.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target:
!! FROBOZZ MAGIC BALLOON COMPANY !!

Hello, Aviator!

To land your balloon, say LAND
Otherwise, you're on your own!

No warranty expressed or implied.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A path leads east-west through a room decorated with beautiful frescoes of someone battling dragons and rescuing fair maidens. It is hard to tell who is doing this as those parts of the frescoes have been blackened and cracked by intense heat.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: The excessively gaudy crown of Lord Dimwit Flathead sits in the safe.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A strangely familiar brass lantern is lying on the ground.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A beautiful young woman, wearing a dirty and bedraggled gown, sits on a rock in the corner. Her hair is unkempt and she is oblivious to your presence, almost in a trance.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the middle part of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls and a dim illumination comes from mosses far above. The path is of small crushed white stones. It winds among bushes and flower beds from south to north. To the north a small structure can be seen. To the south are peculiarly shaped bushes. There is a small gap in the hedges to the west.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a dark tunnel with dim light to the northeast. The tunnel is smooth but dusty and filled with twigs and leaves, debris which becomes deeper as the tunnel branches into a wide corridor leading southwest and a narrower one leading southeast.

fields.name: SW
fields.target: You are trying to walk through an enormous rock.

fields.name: WEST
fields.target: You don't even have an ice-pick.

fields.name: EAST
fields.target: The huge dog snaps nastily at you.

fields.name: IN
fields.target: The huge dog snaps nastily at you.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the entrance to a huge crypt or tomb. A marble stairway leads up from a gateway arch.

fields.name: DOWN
fields.target: As you start down, you slip on the crumbling rocks and pull back, narrowly averting a fatal fall.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are standing at the southern end of a narrow tunnel where it opens into a wide cavern. The cavern is dimly illuminated by phosphorescent mosses clinging to its high ceiling. A deep ravine winds through the cavern, with a small stream at the bottom. The walls of the ravine are steep and crumbly. A foot bridge crosses the ravine to the south.

fields.name: DOWN
fields.target: There are a lot of sharp rocks down there.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A ledge from the east ends here, and a tunnel leads north into the wall. There is a rather odd smokey odor in the warm air of the tunnel.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: The room is cool and damp. The air is misty. A twisty path from the southeast splits here toward a wide northerly stone bridge, and a narrow westerly tunnel. It is from the latter that the mist and chill seem to originate.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: The text is in some obscure tongue. All that can be made out is a reference to "sending in a matchbook cover."

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano. High above you light enters from the cone of the volcano. The only exit is to the north.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are near the rim of the volcano. Above you it is open to the sky. To the west, there is a place to land on a wide ledge.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: 200 neatly stacked zorkmid bills are here.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: On the floor sit 200 neatly stacked zorkmid bills.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: Each bill is worth 100 zorkmids, and bears the legend "In Frobs We Trust".

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target:
** U.S. News and Dungeon Report **

FAMED ADVENTURER TO EXPLORE GREAT UNDERGROUND EMPIRE

Our correspondents report that a world-famous and battle-hardened adventurer has been seen in the vicinity of the Great Underground Empire. Local grues have been reported sharpening their (slavering) fangs....

"Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz" was written by Dave Lebling and Marc Blank, and is (c) Copyright 1981, 1982, 1983 by Infocom, Inc.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the center of the great cavern, carved out of the limestone. Stalactites and stalagmites of many sizes are everywhere. The room glows with dim light provided by phosphorescent moss, and weird shadows move all around you. A narrow path winds southwest among the stalagmites, and another leads northeast.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are in a tight chimney of solidified lava. It extends up at least another hundred feet and down to a large room far below. A large crack opens to the south, probably the result of a shift in the rock strata.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: EAST
fields.target: Only a mouse could get in there.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a small room containing a large oblong table, no doubt set for afternoon tea. It is clear from the objects on the table that the users were indeed mad. In the eastern corner of the room is a small hole (no more than four inches high). There are passageways leading away to the west and the northwest.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A huge red dragon is lying on the rocks here, watching.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A huge red dragon is lying here, blocking the entrance to a tunnel leading north. Smoke curls from his nostrils and out between his teeth.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: Lying in the dust, and covered with mold, is a purple book.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar. Assuming that one can indeed tell a book by its cover, it is likely filled with purple prose, the like of which is rarely seen outside the Great Underground Empire.

fields.name: NORTH
fields.target: There is a curtain of light there.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a large rectangular room. The east and west walls were used for storing safety deposit boxes, but all have been carefully removed by evil persons. To the east, west, and south of the room are large doorways. The northern "wall" of the room is a shimmering curtain of light. In the center of the room is a large stone cube, about 10 feet on a side. Engraved on the side of the cube is some lettering.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are in the dragon's lair, where the rock walls are scarred by flame. A blackened doorway leads to the south.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target:
This room was used by holders of safety deposit boxes to view their contents. On the north side of the room is a sign which says:

"Remain here while the teller retrieves your safety deposit box. When you are finished, leave the box, and exit to the south. Safety deposit boxes cannot be removed from this room!

Thank You for Banking at the Zork!"

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A winding corridor is filled with cobwebs. Some are broken and the dust on the floor is disturbed. The trend of the twists and turns is northeast to southwest. On the north side of one twist, high up, is a narrow crack.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is a small chamber carved out of the rock at the end of a short crawl. On the wall is crudely chiseled the number "8".

fields.name: DOWN
fields.target: The ravine is extremely deep. You would never make it.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: The path follows the south edge of a deep ravine and heads northeast. A tunnel heads southwest, narrowing to a rather tight crawl. A faint whirring sound can be heard in that direction. On the east is a ruined archway choked with vegetation.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a coil of black, braided string here.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A spray can is in the corner. In large type is the legend "Frobozz Magic Grue Repellent".

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target:
!!! FROBOZZ MAGIC GRUE REPELLENT !!!

Instructions for use: Apply liberally to creature to be protected. Duration of effect is unpredictable. Use only in place of death!

(No warranty expressed or implied)

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the southern end of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls and mosses provide dim illumination. Fantastically shaped hedges and bushes are arrayed with geometric precision. They have not recently been clipped, but you can discern creatures in the shapes of the bushes: There is a dragon, a unicorn, a great serpent, a huge misshapen dog, and several human figures. On the west side of the garden the path leads through a rose arbor into a tunnel.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: On the ground is a small, worn piece of paper.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: The paper is barely readable. You can only make out "... valuables are completely safe ... advanced magic technology ... impossible to take valuables from the depository ... either teller's ... Many customers faint ... teller pops in ... seems to walk through ... walls ..."

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: An Elvish sword of great antiquity is here.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: A sword of Elvish workmanship is on the ground.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a square brick here which feels like clay.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a demon floating in midair here.

fields.name: EAST
fields.target: The stream deepens rapidly, and you wisely return before drowning.

fields.name: WEST
fields.target: You notice that the ledge above would be a drier route west.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: You are fording the stream at a deep but not impossible spot. The water is very cold. The walls of the ravine rise to east and west. There is a small ledge along the north wall of the ravine. To the south is the entrance to a well-constructed but somewhat ruined hall.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: Right beside the purple book sits a white one.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: It is written in an unfamiliar tongue and details the use of various magical objects, chiefly the so-called "magic wand". Apparently these devices work by pointing them at the object to be ensorcelled, and then chanting the appropriate magic words. (It's truly amazing how credulous these ancients were, isn't it?)

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: Here a dark hallway turns a corner. To the south is a dark room, to the east is fitful light.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: This is the northern end of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls, and if you don't look up, the illusion is of a cloudy day outside. The light comes from a large growth of glowing mosses on the roof of the cave. A break in the hedge is almost overgrown to the north. A carefully manicured path leads south. In the center of a rosebed is a small open structure, painted white. It appears to be a gazebo.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A hand-lettered label is affixed to the wall.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target:
Warning!

The exhibits in this room are the property of the mighty Wizard of Frobozz (me), and are the fruits of diligent labor and study over many years. He who touches anything will regret it.

(signed)
Frobozz

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: The floor here seems to be made of sand, but it is hard to see anything else.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a nervous Volcano Gnome here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A marble stairway leads down into the gloom and a passage leads north.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a mangled steel cage here.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is a green piece of paper here.

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target:
!!  FROBOZZ MAGIC ROBOT COMPANY  !!

 Hello, Master!

   I am a late-model robot, trained at GUE Tech to perform various simple household functions.

   To activate me, say the following:

        >ROBOT, <things to do>

At your service!

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: There is an engraved zorkmid here.

fields.name: FDESC
fields.target: On the floor is a priceless gold zorkmid (a valuable collector's item).

fields.name: TEXT
fields.target: This is a beautiful octagonal coin bearing the legends "Ten Thousand Zorkmids" and "In Frobs We Trust".

fields.name: NORTH
fields.target: The dragon hisses at you and blocks your way.

fields.name: IN
fields.target: The dragon hisses at you and blocks your way.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: The room is a large cavern full of broken stone. The walls are scorched and there are deep scratches on the floor. A sooty dry smell is very strong here. A paved path winds from a large passage to the west, through the room, and across a huge stone bridge to the south. To the east a small crack is visible. A dark and smokey tunnel leads north.

fields.name: LDESC
fields.target: Filling the northern half of the room is a huge aquarium.
You should have looked before you leaped.
In the movies, your life would be passing before your eyes.
Very good. Now you can go to the second grade.
Do you expect me to applaud?
You can't swim in the dungeon.
Nice weather we've been having lately.
The lamp appears a bit dimmer.
The lamp is definitely dimmer now.
I think you've already done that.
Dragon hide is tough as steel, but you have succeeded in annoying him a bit. He looks at you as if deciding whether or not to eat you.
That captured his interest. He stares at you balefully.
The dragon is surprised and interested (for the moment).
You've made him rather angry. You had better be very careful now.
That did no damage, but he turns his smoky yellow eyes in your direction and sighs.
There is a large, white animal partly hidden behind some trees.
You catch a glimpse of something white between two hedges.
A unicorn is cropping grass on the other side of the room. A gold key hangs from a ribbon around its neck.
There is a beautiful unicorn eating roses here. Around his neck is a red satin ribbon on which is strung a tiny key.
Most fine, master! But 'tis not enough. I will do a great service, and are not great services bought at great price?
Ah, truly magnificent! Keep them coming.
Almost halfway there, oh worthy one!
Oh, such beauty! Your generosity almost overwhelms me!
Truly I shall do thee a wonderful service when thou hast finished!
Truly you are most generous! But still, this is yet not enough.
A fine gift, mighty one, you have almost reached my fee.
Wondrous fine, master! But one treasure is yet to be given!
All at once you feel very tired.
You look at the Wizard in terror. You scramble away, trying to get as far as possible from him.
Your limbs suddenly feel like they have turned to stone. You can't move a muscle.
You rush at the Wizard, intending to tear him limb from limb.
You suddenly decide that the Wizard isn't that terrifying...
Your little finger begins to twitch, and then your whole body is free again.
You feel cooler and less angry now.
sparsely furnished and almost monkish in its austerity.
an opulently furnished seraglio out of an Arabian folktale.
decorated in the Louis XIV style.
overhung with palm-trees and lianas. The only furniture is a hammock.
constructed of delicate and wispy cloud-stuffs.
furnished in plastic and metal and looks like the control deck of a spaceship.
a suburban bedroom out of the 1950's, complete with bunk beds.
a dank and dimly lighted cave, its floor piled with furs and old bones.

relocations.target: Now you've done it. It seems that the brick has other properties than weight, namely the ability to blow you to smithereens.
As you pass out, you realize that the vapors from the flask's contents are fatal.
You should have looked before you leaped.
In the movies, your life would be passing before your eyes.
Very good. Now you can go to the second grade.
Do you expect me to applaud?
You can't swim in the dungeon.
Nice weather we've been having lately.
The lamp appears a bit dimmer.
The lamp is definitely dimmer now.
I think you've already done that.
Dragon hide is tough as steel, but you have succeeded in annoying him a bit. He looks at you as if deciding whether or not to eat you.
That captured his interest. He stares at you balefully.
The dragon is surprised and interested (for the moment).
You've made him rather angry. You had better be very careful now.
That did no damage, but he turns his smoky yellow eyes in your direction and sighs.
There is a large, white animal partly hidden behind some trees.
You catch a glimpse of something white between two hedges.
A unicorn is cropping grass on the other side of the room. A gold key hangs from a ribbon around its neck.
There is a beautiful unicorn eating roses here. Around his neck is a red satin ribbon on which is strung a tiny key.
Most fine, master! But 'tis not enough. I will do a great service, and are not great services bought at great price?
Ah, truly magnificent! Keep them coming.
Almost halfway there, oh worthy one!
Oh, such beauty! Your generosity almost overwhelms me!
Truly I shall do thee a wonderful service when thou hast finished!
Truly you are most generous! But still, this is yet not enough.
A fine gift, mighty one, you have almost reached my fee.
Wondrous fine, master! But one treasure is yet to be given!
All at once you feel very tired.
You look at the Wizard in terror. You scramble away, trying to get as far as possible from him.
Your limbs suddenly feel like they have turned to stone. You can't move a muscle.
You rush at the Wizard, intending to tear him limb from limb.
You suddenly decide that the Wizard isn't that terrifying...
Your little finger begins to twitch, and then your whole body is free again.
You feel cooler and less angry now.
sparsely furnished and almost monkish in its austerity.
an opulently furnished seraglio out of an Arabian folktale.
decorated in the Louis XIV style.
overhung with palm-trees and lianas. The only furniture is a hammock.
constructed of delicate and wispy cloud-stuffs.
furnished in plastic and metal and looks like the control deck of a spaceship.
a suburban bedroom out of the 1950's, complete with bunk beds.
a dank and dimly lighted cave, its floor piled with furs and old bones.
This is the Vault of the Bank of Zork, in which there are no doors.
Nestled in the chest is a wrought gold statuette of a dragon.
You are at the top of the well. Well done. There are etchings on the side of the well. There is a small crack across the floor at the entrance to a room on the east, but it can be crossed easily.
There is a solid steel cage in the middle of the room.
You are on a narrow ledge within an old dormant volcano. This ledge is about halfway between the floor below and the rim above. There is an exit to the south.
This is a small room, whose walls are formed by an old lava flow. There are exits here to the east and the south.
This is a gazebo in the midst of a formal garden. It is cool and restful here. A tea table adorns the center of the gazebo.
There is a dead sea serpent in a heap here.
The Wizard of Frobozz is here, eyeing you warily.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.
You'll have to specify a direction.
You are standing on a crude but sturdy wooden foot bridge crossing a deep ravine. The path runs north and south from here.
There is a dented steel box here.
There is a matchbook saying "Visit ZORK I" here.

">> Visit Exotic ZORK I <<

Consult the Frobozz Magic Travel Agency, or visit your local computer store for more details."
There is a beautiful unicorn here cropping grass.
There is a beautiful red crystal sphere here.

This is an arched hall of fine marble. The hall stops abruptly to the north at a ford across a stream, where the marble is cracked and broken. Perhaps a flood or collapse of the cave was responsible. To the south the hall opens into a large room. There is rather annoying whirring sound coming from that room.
There is a clear crystal sphere lying in the sand.
There is a baby sea serpent swimming in the aquarium.
In the center of the table sits a blue crystal sphere.
You are about one hundred feet above the bottom of the volcano. The top of the volcano is clearly visible here.
There is a strange black sphere here.
This is a former broom closet. The exits are to the east and west.
The leak has submerged the depressed area in a pool of tears. There is a hazy something at the deepest part of the pool.
A handsome book, bound in green leather, sits in the center of the room.
This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar.
A stoppered glass flask with a skull-and-crossbones marking is here. The flask is filled with some clear liquid.
There is a skull-and-crossbones engraved on the glass.
This is the workshop of the Wizard of Frobozz.
This room was the office of the Chairman of the Bank of Zork. Like the other rooms here, it has been extensively vandalized. The lone exit is to the north.
You may not recall, but when you entered, the door of the barrow shut behind you. There is no way out.
You are inside an ancient barrow hidden deep within a dark forest. The barrow opens into a narrow tunnel at its southern end. You can see a faint glow at the far end.
There is a wooden bucket here, 3 feet in diameter and 3 feet high.

You are at the southern edge of a great cavern. To the south across a shallow ford is a dark tunnel which looks like it was once enlarged and smoothed. To the north a narrow path winds among stalagmites. Dim light illuminates the cavern.

This is a dingy closet adjacent to a larger room to the north. Chiselled into a wall are these words:

     Protected by
       FROBOZZ
 Magic Alarm Company
  (Hello, footpad!)

There doesn't seem to be any footpad here, however.
There is a card with writing on it here.

Warning:
    This room was constructed over very weak rock strata. Detonation of explosives in this room is strictly prohibited!
         Frobozz Magic Cave Company
         per M. Agrippa, foreman
The portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead is here.
A portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead hangs on the wall.
A huge dead dragon is lying half blocking the stream.
There is a vicious-looking dog guarding the entrance. It is more or less your usual dog, except that it has three heads and is the size of an elephant.
There is a balloon here, broken into pieces.
Worn and battered in one corner of the room is a blue book.
This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar.

This is the Wizard's trophy room, filled with memorabilia of various sorts. On one wall is the Wizard's D. T. (Doctor of Thaumaturgy) degree from GUE Tech. Several old magic wands are mounted on a wand rack. A collection of dull and nicked swords testify to the fate of many foolhardy adventurers. Small bottles contain discarded homunculi (a few preserved in alcohol). There is a stuffed owl on a perch.
This is a small, bare room with no distinguishing features. There are no exits from this room.
There is a small hook attached to the rock here.
Shards of a smashed trophy case litter the room.
A long wooden club lies on the ground near the diamond-shaped window. The club is curiously burned at the thick end.
The words "Babe Flathead" are burned into the wood.
A gigantic dog collar, large enough for three rhinoceros-sized dogs, is lying amidst the debris.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.
There is a Flathead stamp here.
This three zorkmid stamp bears a portrait of Lord Dimwit Flathead, "Our Excessive Leader".
You'll have to specify a direction.

This is the middle of a ruined but still impressive stone bridge spanning a deep chasm. Water flows far beneath. A paved path leads north into a large open space. To the south, the path leads into a misty tunnel.
A rotten old wooden chest is in one corner among the debris.
This is a large room, one half of which is depressed. Salty water flows from a large leak in the ceiling. The only exit is to the west.
You are high above the floor of the volcano. The rim of the volcano looks very narrow and you are very near it. To the east is what appears to be a viewing ledge, too thin to land on.

This is a large room full of assorted heavy machinery, whirring noisily. The room smells of burned resistors. Along one wall are three buttons which are, respectively, round, triangular, and square. Naturally, above these buttons are instructions written in EBCDIC. A large sign in English above all the buttons says
       "DANGER -- HIGH VOLTAGE"
There are exits to the west and the south.
There is a small hook attached to the rock here.
In this room, inscribed on the floor, is a great pentagram drawn with black chalk. In its center is a black circle.

This is the entrance hall of the Bank of Zork, the largest banking institution of the Great Underground Empire. A partial account of its history is in "The Lives of the Twelve Flatheads," in the chapter on J. Pierpont Flathead. A more detailed history (albeit less objective) may be found in Flathead's outrageous autobiography "I'm Rich and You Aren't - So There!". Most of the furniture has been ravaged by passing scavengers. All that remains are two signs at the northwest and northeast corners of the room, which say:

    <--  VIEWING ROOMS  -->

The way out (ornate but tasteful) is to the east.

This room is the Wizard's workroom. A hall continues east and west, and a larger room lies to the south. There are many shelves and racks on the walls, but the Wizard's workbench dominates the room. It is made of dark, heavy wood bound with iron. The workbench is stained from many years of use, and is deeply gouged as though some huge clawed animal was imprisoned on it. There are burn marks and even notes written in a crabbed hand. Many arcane items are scattered about the bench; alembics, mortar and pestle, small knives of various sizes, odd scraps of vellum, wax candles, and much more. In the center of a relatively clear area of the bench are affixed three stands - ruby, sapphire, and diamond - which form a triangle.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.
There is a moby ruby lying here.
On the floor lies a moby ruby.
The room is cluttered with debris from an explosion. The walls seem ready to collapse.

This room was used by holders of safety deposit boxes to view their contents. On the north side of the room is a sign which says

"Remain here while the teller retrieves your safety deposit box. When you are finished, leave the box, and exit to the south. Safety deposit boxes cannot be removed from this room!

Thank You for Banking at the Zork!"
You are trapped inside a solid steel cage.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
You are about two hundred feet above the volcano floor. Looming above is the rim of the volcano. There is a small ledge on the west side.
"Here lie the Flatheads, whose heads were placed on poles by the Keeper of the Dungeon for amazing untastefulness."
It is impossible to cross this distance.

You are on a ledge in the middle of a large volcano. Below you the volcano bottom can be seen and above is the rim of the volcano. A couple of ledges can be seen on the other side of the volcano; it appears that this ledge is intermediate in elevation between those on the other side. The exit from this room is to the east.
This is a damp circular room, whose walls are made of brick and mortar. The roof of this room is not visible, but there appear to be some etchings on the walls. There is a passageway to the west.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.
A great chasm blocks your way.
A great chasm blocks your way.
A great chasm blocks your way.

This is an enormous room, in the center of which are four wooden posts delineating a rectangular area, above which is what appears to be a wooden roof. In fact, all objects in this room appear to be abnormally large. To the east is a passageway. There are large gaping chasms to the west and northwest.

You are on a narrow ledge near the bottom of a deep ravine. The ledge continues to the west. A precarious climb up to another tiny ledge is possible. A short scramble down the rock face leads to a stream.
You are trying to walk through an enormous rock.
You are trying to walk through an enormous rock.

This room looks like it was once a kennel for a very large dog (some of the bones would fit a dinosaur). It apparently hasn't been used for a long time, as the dust is fairly thick all over. The only exit is northeast.
Imbedded in the wall is an ornate trophy cabinet.
There is a package of candied goodies here.
There is a Gnome of Zurich here.
There is a pearl necklace here with hundreds of large pearls.
This must have been a large library, probably for the royal family. All of the shelves have been gnawed to pieces by unfriendly gnomes. To the north is an exit.
There is a blue label here.

!! FROBOZZ MAGIC BALLOON COMPANY !!

Hello, Aviator!

To land your balloon, say LAND
Otherwise, you're on your own!

No warranty expressed or implied.

A path leads east-west through a room decorated with beautiful frescoes of someone battling dragons and rescuing fair maidens. It is hard to tell who is doing this as those parts of the frescoes have been blackened and cracked by intense heat.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.
The excessively gaudy crown of Lord Dimwit Flathead sits in the safe.
A strangely familiar brass lantern is lying on the ground.
A beautiful young woman, wearing a dirty and bedraggled gown, sits on a rock in the corner. Her hair is unkempt and she is oblivious to your presence, almost in a trance.

This is the middle part of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls and a dim illumination comes from mosses far above. The path is of small crushed white stones. It winds among bushes and flower beds from south to north. To the north a small structure can be seen. To the south are peculiarly shaped bushes. There is a small gap in the hedges to the west.

This is a dark tunnel with dim light to the northeast. The tunnel is smooth but dusty and filled with twigs and leaves, debris which becomes deeper as the tunnel branches into a wide corridor leading southwest and a narrower one leading southeast.
You are trying to walk through an enormous rock.
You don't even have an ice-pick.
The huge dog snaps nastily at you.
The huge dog snaps nastily at you.
This is the entrance to a huge crypt or tomb. A marble stairway leads up from a gateway arch.
As you start down, you slip on the crumbling rocks and pull back, narrowly averting a fatal fall.

You are standing at the southern end of a narrow tunnel where it opens into a wide cavern. The cavern is dimly illuminated by phosphorescent mosses clinging to its high ceiling. A deep ravine winds through the cavern, with a small stream at the bottom. The walls of the ravine are steep and crumbly. A foot bridge crosses the ravine to the south.
There are a lot of sharp rocks down there.
A ledge from the east ends here, and a tunnel leads north into the wall. There is a rather odd smokey odor in the warm air of the tunnel.

The room is cool and damp. The air is misty. A twisty path from the southeast splits here toward a wide northerly stone bridge, and a narrow westerly tunnel. It is from the latter that the mist and chill seem to originate.
The text is in some obscure tongue. All that can be made out is a reference to "sending in a matchbook cover."
You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano. High above you light enters from the cone of the volcano. The only exit is to the north.
You are near the rim of the volcano. Above you it is open to the sky. To the west, there is a place to land on a wide ledge.
200 neatly stacked zorkmid bills are here.
On the floor sit 200 neatly stacked zorkmid bills.
Each bill is worth 100 zorkmids, and bears the legend "In Frobs We Trust".

** U.S. News and Dungeon Report **

FAMED ADVENTURER TO EXPLORE GREAT UNDERGROUND EMPIRE

Our correspondents report that a world-famous and battle-hardened adventurer has been seen in the vicinity of the Great Underground Empire. Local grues have been reported sharpening their (slavering) fangs....

"Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz" was written by Dave Lebling and Marc Blank, and is (c) Copyright 1981, 1982, 1983 by Infocom, Inc.

This is the center of the great cavern, carved out of the limestone. Stalactites and stalagmites of many sizes are everywhere. The room glows with dim light provided by phosphorescent moss, and weird shadows move all around you. A narrow path winds southwest among the stalagmites, and another leads northeast.

You are in a tight chimney of solidified lava. It extends up at least another hundred feet and down to a large room far below. A large crack opens to the south, probably the result of a shift in the rock strata.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.
Only a mouse could get in there.

This is a small room containing a large oblong table, no doubt set for afternoon tea. It is clear from the objects on the table that the users were indeed mad. In the eastern corner of the room is a small hole (no more than four inches high). There are passageways leading away to the west and the northwest.
A huge red dragon is lying on the rocks here, watching.
A huge red dragon is lying here, blocking the entrance to a tunnel leading north. Smoke curls from his nostrils and out between his teeth.
Lying in the dust, and covered with mold, is a purple book.

This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar. Assuming that one can indeed tell a book by its cover, it is likely filled with purple prose, the like of which is rarely seen outside the Great Underground Empire.
There is a curtain of light there.

This is a large rectangular room. The east and west walls were used for storing safety deposit boxes, but all have been carefully removed by evil persons. To the east, west, and south of the room are large doorways. The northern "wall" of the room is a shimmering curtain of light. In the center of the room is a large stone cube, about 10 feet on a side. Engraved on the side of the cube is some lettering.
You are in the dragon's lair, where the rock walls are scarred by flame. A blackened doorway leads to the south.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.

This room was used by holders of safety deposit boxes to view their contents. On the north side of the room is a sign which says:

"Remain here while the teller retrieves your safety deposit box. When you are finished, leave the box, and exit to the south. Safety deposit boxes cannot be removed from this room!

Thank You for Banking at the Zork!"

A winding corridor is filled with cobwebs. Some are broken and the dust on the floor is disturbed. The trend of the twists and turns is northeast to southwest. On the north side of one twist, high up, is a narrow crack.
This is a small chamber carved out of the rock at the end of a short crawl. On the wall is crudely chiseled the number "8".
The ravine is extremely deep. You would never make it.

The path follows the south edge of a deep ravine and heads northeast. A tunnel heads southwest, narrowing to a rather tight crawl. A faint whirring sound can be heard in that direction. On the east is a ruined archway choked with vegetation.
There is a coil of black, braided string here.
A spray can is in the corner. In large type is the legend "Frobozz Magic Grue Repellent".

!!! FROBOZZ MAGIC GRUE REPELLENT !!!

Instructions for use: Apply liberally to creature to be protected. Duration of effect is unpredictable. Use only in place of death!

(No warranty expressed or implied)

This is the southern end of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls and mosses provide dim illumination. Fantastically shaped hedges and bushes are arrayed with geometric precision. They have not recently been clipped, but you can discern creatures in the shapes of the bushes: There is a dragon, a unicorn, a great serpent, a huge misshapen dog, and several human figures. On the west side of the garden the path leads through a rose arbor into a tunnel.
On the ground is a small, worn piece of paper.

The paper is barely readable. You can only make out "... valuables are completely safe ... advanced magic technology ... impossible to take valuables from the depository ... either teller's ... Many customers faint ... teller pops in ... seems to walk through ... walls ..."
An Elvish sword of great antiquity is here.
A sword of Elvish workmanship is on the ground.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.
There is a demon floating in midair here.
The stream deepens rapidly, and you wisely return before drowning.
You notice that the ledge above would be a drier route west.

You are fording the stream at a deep but not impossible spot. The water is very cold. The walls of the ravine rise to east and west. There is a small ledge along the north wall of the ravine. To the south is the entrance to a well-constructed but somewhat ruined hall.
Right beside the purple book sits a white one.

It is written in an unfamiliar tongue and details the use of various magical objects, chiefly the so-called "magic wand". Apparently these devices work by pointing them at the object to be ensorcelled, and then chanting the appropriate magic words. (It's truly amazing how credulous these ancients were, isn't it?)
Here a dark hallway turns a corner. To the south is a dark room, to the east is fitful light.

This is the northern end of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls, and if you don't look up, the illusion is of a cloudy day outside. The light comes from a large growth of glowing mosses on the roof of the cave. A break in the hedge is almost overgrown to the north. A carefully manicured path leads south. In the center of a rosebed is a small open structure, painted white. It appears to be a gazebo.
A hand-lettered label is affixed to the wall.

Warning!

The exhibits in this room are the property of the mighty Wizard of Frobozz (me), and are the fruits of diligent labor and study over many years. He who touches anything will regret it.

(signed)
Frobozz
The floor here seems to be made of sand, but it is hard to see anything else.
There is a nervous Volcano Gnome here.
A marble stairway leads down into the gloom and a passage leads north.
There is a mangled steel cage here.
A small room with oddly angled walls and passages in all directions.
There is a green piece of paper here.

!!  FROBOZZ MAGIC ROBOT COMPANY  !!

 Hello, Master!

   I am a late-model robot, trained at GUE Tech to perform various simple household functions.

   To activate me, say the following:

        >ROBOT, <things to do>

At your service!
There is an engraved zorkmid here.
On the floor is a priceless gold zorkmid (a valuable collector's item).
This is a beautiful octagonal coin bearing the legends "Ten Thousand Zorkmids" and "In Frobs We Trust".
The dragon hisses at you and blocks your way.
The dragon hisses at you and blocks your way.

The room is a large cavern full of broken stone. The walls are scorched and there are deep scratches on the floor. A sooty dry smell is very strong here. A paved path winds from a large passage to the west, through the room, and across a huge stone bridge to the south. To the east a small crack is visible. A dark and smokey tunnel leads north.
Filling the northern half of the room is a huge aquarium.
